engines.language_notes: Japanese preset voice path; streaming output is exposed through the managed mlx_audio bridge on Apple Silicon.
engines.notes: Apple Silicon only. 8-bit 0.6B preset Japanese voice (Ono_Anna). Install the managed mlx_audio runtime with `pnpm kyberion voice setup --tool mlx_audio --apply`; model weights are not downloaded by setup and must already be present in the managed Hugging Face cache. For real-time PCM streaming use this bridge in --stream mode.
